name: Intent To Pay Notification V 02
definition: Scope|The IntentToPayNotification message is sent by a party to the matching application in order to provide details about a future payment.|This message contains details about an intention to pay a certain amount, on a certain date, in relation to one or several transactions known to the matching application.|Usage|The IntentToPayNotification message can be sent by a party to the transaction at any time as long as the transaction is established and not yet closed.|The message is unsolicited, that is, it is not sent in response to another message.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the transaction.|This identification is to be used in any communication between the parties.

SubmitterTransactionReference.name: Submitter Transaction Reference
SubmitterTransactionReference.definition: Reference to the transaction for the requesting financial institution.

BuyerBank.name: Buyer Bank
BuyerBank.definition: The financial institution of the buyer, uniquely identified by its BIC. |.

SellerBank.name: Seller Bank
SellerBank.definition: The financial institution of the seller, uniquely identified by its BIC. |.

IntentToPay.name: Intent To Pay
IntentToPay.definition: Provides the details of the intention to pay.
